name: 10pipsOnceADayOppositeLastNHourTrend
summary: This EA opens one trade per day against the trend of the last N hours, targeting a small 10-pip profit. It identifies the prevailing trend over a configurable lookback period and enters a contrarian position, aiming to capture a quick retracement. The strategy is a classic once-a-day scalping mean-reversion system.
summary_zh: 该EA每天只交易一次，逆着最近N小时的趋势方向开仓，目标获利10点。它通过可配置的回溯期识别当前主导趋势，然后反向开仓捕捉短期回撤。这是一个典型的日内一次均值回归剥头皮策略。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是均值回归，逆势交易，基于最近N小时的趋势方向进行反向操作。入场条件为：计算最近N小时的 价格走势判断趋势方向，如果是上升趋势则做空，如果是下降趋势则做多，且每天仅交易一次。出场条件为：达到10点止盈目标后平仓，同时设有止损保护。仓位管理方面，支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能支持基于资金比例的仓位计算。资金管理较为简单，缺乏动态调整机制，且每日一次交易限制了过度交易风险。该策略依赖市场在短期趋势后的回撤现象，但在强趋势市场中可能连续止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is mean reversion, trading against the prevailing trend of the last N hours. Entry conditions: the EA evaluates the price movement over the last N hours to determine the dominant trend direction, then opens a contrarian position — selling if the trend is up, buying if the trend is down — with a strict one-trade-per-day limit. Exit conditions: positions are closed upon reaching a 10-pip take profit target, with a stop loss in place for capital protection. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots, though some versions may support percentage-based sizing. Money management is relatively simplistic without dynamic adjustment mechanisms. The daily trade limit prevents overtrading, but the strategy relies on the assumption that short-term retracements follow trending moves, which can fail in strong trending markets leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: N_Hours
parameters.description: 回溯小时数，用于判断趋势方向

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number; 0 to manage all orders

pros: 每天仅交易一次，有效避免过度交易和情绪化操作
逆势策略在震荡行情和趋势反转时表现较好，能捕捉短期回撤
策略逻辑简单明了，参数少，易于理解和调优
pros_en: One trade per day limit effectively prevents overtrading and emotional decision-making
Contrarian approach performs well in ranging markets and during trend reversals, capturing short-term retracements
Simple and clear strategy logic with few parameters, easy to understand and optimize
cons: 逆势交易在强趋势市场中容易连续止损，风险较大
10点止盈目标过小，容易被点差和滑点侵蚀实际利润
缺乏动态仓位和风险管理机制，无法根据市场波动率自适应调整
cons_en: Counter-trend trading is prone to consecutive stop losses in strong trending markets, posing significant risk
10-pip take profit target is very small and can be easily eroded by spread and slippage
Lacks dynamic position sizing and risk management mechanisms, unable to adapt to changing market volatility
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤器，在强趋势行情中暂停交易或减少仓位
加入动态止盈止损机制，根据ATR或波动率自动调整目标
增加点差过滤器，避免在点差过大时开仓以保护利润
improvements_en: Add a trend strength filter to pause trading or reduce position size during strong trending conditions
Implement dynamic take profit and stop loss based on ATR or volatility for adaptive targets
Add a spread filter to avoid opening positions when spreads are too wide, protecting thin profit margins

risk_points: 逆势交易在强单边行情中可能造成连续止损
10点止盈较小，点差和滑点对实际收益影响显著
每日一次交易限制虽降低频率但无法防止单笔大亏损
risk_points_en: Counter-trend entries can result in consecutive stop losses during strong directional markets
Small 10-pip target makes the strategy highly sensitive to spread and slippage costs
Daily trade limit reduces frequency but does not prevent large single-trade losses

It identifies the prevailing trend over a configurable lookback period and enters a contrarian position, aiming to capture a quick retracement. The strategy is a classic once-a-day scalping mean-reversion system.
